sources.title: Compressed Air Leak Detection
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 高速轉子動平衡
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：體積基準一致，分鐘到小時換算正確，修復後有對照量測。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Volume references agree, minute/hour conversion is correct, and a post-repair control measurement is planned.
related.difference: 區分不平衡量g·mm與振動幅度，說明校正質量位置和相位的重要性。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish unbalance in g·mm from vibration amplitude and explain correction radius and phase.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 若用實測平均比能耗e，洩漏能量E=q_leak te；此估算忽略卸載控制造成的非線性。 合成洩漏0.30 m³/min、運行4000 h/年、平均比能耗0.11 kWh/m³，三者使用同一自由空氣基準。 漏氣體積0.30×60×4000=72000 m³/年；耗能7920 kWh/年。
不平衡量U=mr，離心力幅F=Uω²；U需先換成kg·m。單平面模型不處理力偶不平衡。 教學不平衡量10 g·mm，轉速3000 rpm，虛擬校正半徑50 mm。 U=10^−5 kg·m，ω=100π rad/s，F=0.98696 N；理想反相校正質量10/50=0.20 g。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With measured average specific energy e, leak energy E=q_leak te; the estimate omits unloading-control nonlinearities. Synthetic leak 0.30 m³/min,4000 h/year, specific energy 0.11 k Wh/m³, all on one free-air reference basis. Leak volume=72000 m³/year; estimated energy 7920 k Wh/year.

Unbalance U=mr gives centrifugal-force amplitude F=U ω²; convert U to kg·m. A single-plane model excludes couple unbalance. Teaching unbalance 10 g·mm, speed 3000 rpm, virtual correction radius 50 mm. U=10^−5 kg·m, ω=100 π rad/s, F=0.98696 N; ideal opposite-phase correction mass=10/50=0.20 g.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 真空吸附搬運工站
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：體積基準一致，分鐘到小時換算正確，修復後有對照量測。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Volume references agree, minute/hour conversion is correct, and a post-repair control measurement is planned.
related.difference: 區分絕對壓力與壓差、理論保持力與可用負載，建立失壓情境。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish absolute pressure from differential pressure and theoretical force from allowable load.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 若用實測平均比能耗e，洩漏能量E=q_leak te；此估算忽略卸載控制造成的非線性。 合成洩漏0.30 m³/min、運行4000 h/年、平均比能耗0.11 kWh/m³，三者使用同一自由空氣基準。 漏氣體積0.30×60×4000=72000 m³/年；耗能7920 kWh/年。
理論法向保持力F=ΔpA；有效面積與密封、表面粗糙及動態負載會改變實際能力。 教學圓吸盤有效直徑40 mm，壓差60 kPa，質量2 kg，靜態比較係數2。 A=π(0.04²)/4=0.00125664 m²；F=75.3982 N，需求2×2×9.81=39.24 N。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With measured average specific energy e, leak energy E=q_leak te; the estimate omits unloading-control nonlinearities. Synthetic leak 0.30 m³/min,4000 h/year, specific energy 0.11 k Wh/m³, all on one free-air reference basis. Leak volume=72000 m³/year; estimated energy 7920 k Wh/year.

Theoretical normal force F=Δ pA; effective area, sealing, roughness and dynamics affect actual capability. Teaching effective diameter 40 mm, pressure difference 60 k Pa, mass 2 kg, static comparison factor 2. A=0.00125664 m²; F=75.3982 N versus demand 39.24 N.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
